patterns.label: Office macro marker
patterns.reason: Office files containing VBA projects can contain macros and should be reviewed.

patterns.label: AutoOpen macro marker
patterns.reason: AutoOpen macros can run when a document opens.

patterns.label: PowerShell encoded command
patterns.reason: Encoded PowerShell commands are frequently used to hide behavior.

patterns.label: Invoice payment lure
patterns.reason: Invoice-themed urgency can be used in phishing and business email compromise.

patterns.label: Enable content lure
patterns.reason: Requests to enable content or macros are common malicious document lures.
